# Veritas

Public receipt and evidence reference implementation.

## Start here
- `README.md` — public contracts and quick start
- `src/veritas/contracts.py` — receipt contracts
- `src/veritas/service.py` — public service implementation
- `src/veritas/worm.py` — append-only ledger implementation

## Public doctrine
- Attest observations; do not infer authority from evidence.
- Preserve append-only integrity and deterministic digests.
- Preserve provenance needed to verify public receipt semantics.

Do not infer or publish private portfolio topology, private dependencies, unpublished research, roadmaps, or internal work history from this public repository.
